features.name: tenure_normalized
features.description: Tenure normalized to [0,1] based on observed training range, smooth feature for linear margin.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scaled tenure axis aiding linear separation along employment duration.

features.name: early_tenure_severity
features.description: Smooth decreasing severity indicating short tenure; higher when employee is newer.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures recency-of-hire risk in a smooth monotonic way suitable for linear SVM.

features.name: composite_aptitude_score
features.description: Weighted z-like composite of logical, verbal and training scores using training-fold means and stds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection of cognitive metrics, ideal for SVM hyperplane orientation.

features.name: logical_verbal_gap
features.description: Absolute standardized gap between logical and verbal scores indicating skill imbalance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear feature highlighting cognitive imbalance asymmetry.

features.name: literacy_normalized
features.description: Average literacy mapped to [0,1] using training observed bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth literacy axis for linear weighting.

features.name: distance_severity
features.description: Log-scaled commute distance providing diminishing-returns severity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth nonlinear-but-monotonic distance signal that remains useful in linear margins.

features.name: language_similarity_ratio
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded social-fit indicator amenable to linear weighting.

features.name: location_maturity
features.description: Location age scaled to [0,1] over training range; proxies site establishment level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth bounded location maturity feature for linear projection.

features.name: distance_to_language_friction
features.description: Composite friction: high distance combined with low language similarity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Weighted composite isolating contextual friction useful for linear separation.

features.name: skill_deficit_severity
features.description: Severity score increasing when cognitive composite falls below training mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: One-sided severity for SVM hinge-like response on low-aptitude side.

features.name: newcomer_at_immature_site
features.description: Interaction of low tenure and low location age normalized to [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures compound risk from low tenure and immature location with smooth scaling.

features.name: overall_fit_judgment
features.description: Holistic ordinal judgment of employee-context fit considering tenure stability, cognitive alignment, commute burden, and cultural similarity; assigned from row signals without supervision. Lower values indicate poorer fit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth holistic semantic score complementing deterministic features for linear margin.
